purpose: Identify a point, entity or status with a compact marker.
avoid: Do not encode identity solely by marker appearance.
basis: Pinned React/primitive sources lead API, lifecycle and semantics; native visual observations and explicit reference decisions are mapped in figma/traceability.json.
profileRationale: Meaningful native content or a content container in its default source mode. Interactive descendants/native render overrides keep their own native or component contracts; no decorative fallback or invented selection API.
contentAlternative: MarkerContent contains the actual boundary/status text. MarkerIcon is hidden by the source and cannot be the only meaning.
updatesAndDescendants: Marker defaults to a div through useRender; variants change appearance without creating selection or navigation state. Parent content changes update the text. If a caller supplies a native interactive render, its native contract applies.
referenceDecision: Unread messages is a concrete textual boundary label, not a value protocol inferred from the icon name.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: Marker maps all three actual wrappers. Native 8px spacing, 16px icon and 14/20px muted text remain semantic roles; native separator lines become flexible pseudo-elements and the border variant adds a logical bottom boundary after 8px separation. The guide shows inline notes, labeled separators and bordered rows; variant alone does not add ARIA separator/status or control semantics. MarkerIcon is actually aria-hidden, so essential meaning stays in text. A caller may explicitly choose role=status for changing work feedback or render a native action. The native guide says asChild, while the pinned selected BaseUI wrapper exposes render; the contract follows the actual render API and retains the guide as source evidence. Optional shimmer is an external caller style utility, not an invented Marker prop or required animation.
